current_example.problem: Determine the quotient and remainder of $6x^3-x^2+3x+1$ divided by $3x^2+x+2.$
current_example.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,2x-1 \\  & 3{x}^{2}+x+2\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,6{x}^{3}-\phantom{0}{x}^{2}+3x+1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{6{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+4x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-3{x}^{2}-x+1 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{-\,3{x}^{2}-x-2}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is ${\color{blue}2x-1},$ and

- the remainder is ${\color{red}3}.$
